info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce Connect REST API (Communities)
Feeds
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get News Feed

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order of feed elements

items.docs: Returns the news feed for the context user within the specified Experience Cloud site. Includes feed items from people and records the user follows, groups the user is a member of, and site-wide posts.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Post a Feed Element

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Creates a new feed element (post) on the news feed of the specified Experience Cloud site. Supports text posts, link posts, and content posts with mentions and hashtags.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get a Feed Element

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: feedElementId
params.description: The ID of the feed element

items.docs: Returns a specific feed element by its ID within the specified Experience Cloud site, including the body, comments, and likes.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Delete a Feed Element

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: feedElementId
params.description: The ID of the feed element

items.docs: Deletes the specified feed element from the Experience Cloud site. Requires ownership of the feed element or moderation permissions.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Comments on a Feed Element

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: feedElementId
params.description: The ID of the feed element

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results

items.docs: Returns the comments on a specific feed element within the Experience Cloud site.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Post a Comment

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: feedElementId
params.description: The ID of the feed element

items.docs: Creates a new comment on the specified feed element within the Experience Cloud site.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Likes on a Feed Element

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: feedElementId
params.description: The ID of the feed element

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results

items.docs: Returns the likes on a specific feed element within the Experience Cloud site.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Like a Feed Element

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: feedElementId
params.description: The ID of the feed element

items.docs: Adds a like to the specified feed element in the Experience Cloud site on behalf of the context user.

info.name: Topics
Salesforce Experience Cloud List Topics

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results

params.name: q
params.description: Search term to filter topics by name

params.name: exactMatch
params.description: Whether to match the search term exactly

items.docs: Returns a list of topics in the specified Experience Cloud site. Topics organize content and enable community members to find relevant discussions and knowledge.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Create a Topic

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Creates a new topic in the specified Experience Cloud site.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get a Topic

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: topicId
params.description: The ID of the topic

items.docs: Returns details about a specific topic in the Experience Cloud site, including name, description, and related feed items.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Update a Topic

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: topicId
params.description: The ID of the topic

items.docs: Updates the name or description of an existing topic in the Experience Cloud site.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Delete a Topic

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: topicId
params.description: The ID of the topic

items.docs: Deletes the specified topic from the Experience Cloud site. Requires appropriate moderation permissions.

info.name: Members
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Current User

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Returns information about the context user in the specified Experience Cloud site, including profile details, reputation, and community membership information.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud List Community Members

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results

params.name: q
params.description: Search term to filter members by name

items.docs: Returns a list of users in the specified Experience Cloud site. Supports pagination and filtering.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get User Reputation

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user

items.docs: Returns the reputation score and level for a specific user within the Experience Cloud site.

info.name: Knowledge
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Knowledge Articles

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results

params.name: language
params.description: Language code to filter articles

params.name: managedContentType
params.description: Content type to filter by

items.docs: Returns knowledge articles published to the specified Experience Cloud site. Supports filtering by category and language.

info.name: Moderation
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Flagged Elements

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results

params.name: visibility
params.description: Filter by flagged element visibility

items.docs: Returns content that has been flagged for moderation within the Experience Cloud site. Requires moderation permissions.
